package mcp

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/compozy/compozy/internal/tools"
)

func TestEncodeHostedListingBaseline(t *testing.T) {
	t.Parallel()
	t.Run("Should capture the pre-budget list payload", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Parallel()
		views := []tools.ToolView{
			hostedToolView(tools.ToolIDToolSearch),
			hostedToolView(tools.ToolIDToolInfo),
			hostedToolView("compozy__hosted_echo"),
		}
		for _, name := range []string{"alpha", "beta"} {
			view := hostedToolView(tools.ToolID("mcp__large__" + name))
			view.Descriptor.Source = tools.SourceRef{
				Kind: tools.SourceMCP, Owner: "large", RawServerName: "large", RawToolName: name,
			}
			view.Descriptor.Backend = tools.BackendRef{Kind: tools.BackendMCP, MCPServer: "large", MCPTool: name}
			views = append(views, view)
		}
		server := newHostedProxyTestServer()
		applyHostedTools(server, &hostedProxyClientStub{}, "bind-base", views)
		server.AddReceivingMiddleware(privateToolListCacheMiddleware())
		list, err := connectHostedProxyClient(t, server).ListTools(t.Context(), nil)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		payload, err := json.Marshal(list)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(os.Getenv("HOSTED_LIST_BASELINE_OUTPUT"), append(payload, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	})
}
